responsibility: This file implements quiet-mode filtered progress printing for the mc front end. It wraps the mcPrintf fixed-arity output routines and suppresses their output whenever the quiet option is enabled in mcOptions, providing the dedicated status-message channel used by compilation-driver code without affecting error diagnostics.
same_name_distinction: This .cc file is the implementation behind GmcQuiet.h, defining qprintf wrappers that consult mcOptions_getQuiet and delegate to mcPrintf only when nonessential output is enabled.
